css: .status-card { left:940px; top:240px; width:820px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:26px 34px 24px; background:var(--second); border-color:var(--second) } .status-ln { margin:0 0 16px; font-size:31px; color:var(--ground) } .status-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:12px 0; border-top:2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ground) 14%, transparent) } .status-row span { font-size:30px; color:var(--ground) } .status-pill { font-size:26px; font-weight:600; padding:8px 20px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--mute); color:var(--ground); white-space:nowrap } .status-pill.ok { background:var(--jade) } .status-note { margin:14px 0 0; font-size:24px; color:var(--mute) }
